Forthos Dungeon - OSRS Wiki
s: The grubby chest is located behind a locked gate in the south-west corner of Forthos Dungeon. Players must have level 57 Thieving in order to unlock the gate, granting 10 experience when opened. Players can unlock the chest with a grubby key, which can be obtained as a drop from the monsters in the dungeon or from gourmet implings.
